occurrences.text: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.
And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
